8-Day Best of Egypt Tour: Cairo, Nile & Abu Simbel
summary:
The 8-Day Best of Egypt Tour splits the journey between Cairo and three nights cruising the Nile from Aswan to Luxor. Start at the Pyramids of Giza and Saqqara before flying south, with a visit to Abu Simbel bringing you close to the monumental temples of Ramses II. From Aswan, the cruise follows the Nile north toward Luxor, where Karnak Temple and the Valley of the Kings complete the route.
Travel can be arranged year-round around your preferred dates. Selected 5-star hotels, a 3-night Nile cruise, daily breakfast, domestic flights, English-speaking local guides, transfers and scheduled sightseeing are arranged as part of the journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Pyramids, Memphis & Saqqara
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Aswan & Nile Cruise
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight to Aswan.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to board your Nile River cruise ship, followed by embarkation before lunch.
In the afternoon, enjoy a guided tour of Aswan including the impressive Aswan High Dam, the ancient Unfinished Obelisk, and the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island. Return to the cruise ship for dinner. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo and Edfu
itinerary.text:
Optional early morning excursion to the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples, depending on the cruise schedule.
Later, sail along the Nile River to Kom Ombo and visit the unique double Temple of Kom Ombo dedicated to the gods Sobek and Haroeris. Continue cruising to Edfu and explore the remarkably preserved Temple of Edfu, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank
itinerary.text: Sail to Esna and continue to Luxor. Visit the famous Valley of the Kings and Valley of the Queens, followed by the impressive Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut. Stop for photos at the Colossi of Memnon before returning to your Nile River cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: East Bank - Flight to Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise followed by disembarkation from your Nile River cruise ship. Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple and the impressive Karnak Temple Complex. After some free time at leisure, transfer to Luxor International Airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Cairo?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Cairo covers Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan. You will discover the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx in Cairo, explore the magnificent temples and tombs of Luxor, and experience the beauty of Aswan while enjoying a relaxing Nile Cruise through the heart of ancient Egypt. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Cairo cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,595 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes hotel accommodation, a Nile Cruise, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and cruise transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and cruise availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights within Egypt. These flights allow travelers to comfortably visit Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan while minimizing travel time between destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels in Cairo and a Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan. Daily breakfast is included at the hotels, while meals onboard the cruise are provided according to the cruise program.

faqs.q: Does the 8-day Egypt tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking or Spanish-speaking Egyptologist guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide detailed explanations of Egypt's fascinating history, monuments, and cultural heritage.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines Egypt's most famous attractions, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Nile River, Luxor's temples, and Aswan's historic landmarks, providing a comprehensive introduction to the country.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, temples, museums, and cruise ports. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan?
faqs.a: Cairo is renowned for the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. Luxor is home to Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple, and the Valley of the Kings. Aswan features the Philae Temple, the High Dam, beautiful Nile scenery, and rich Nubian culture.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Cairo?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 8-Day Egypt Tour with Nile Cruise & Cairo be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Cairo, include Abu Simbel, upgrade hotels or cruise cabins, extend your stay to the Red Sea resorts, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
